name: pi05_image_perturbations_v1

noise.reference: same-condition inverse of policy-generated full internal trajectory
noise.reuse: fixed recovered noise throughout each image arm; random_noise uses rank8 perturbations

images.coordinates: integer half-open xyxy in original 224x224 policy image
images.rounding: float64 separate convex terms; clip[0,255]; floor(value+0.5); uint8
images.application: apply current specification independently to each fresh raw policy observation at steps0,5,10,15,20 within each decision interval
images.failure: clear prior specification at scheduled refresh; rejected calls use raw inputs until next scheduled call; no retry
images.library: first pinned standard training episode for each of nine published donor tasks; paired frames at nearest_integer((length-1)*q/4), ties upward for q=0..4;45 paired images
images.preprocessing: same camera, upstream orientation unchanged, official OpenPI resize_with_pad to224
images.random_control: independent deterministic RNG per case, arm and rollout; each interval has10% empty choice; otherwise choose uniformly external, wrist or both. Donor uniform45; alpha uniform[0,1). Occlusion width uniform integer1..W; height uniform integer1..min(H,floor(0.5*W*H/width)); origin uniform over valid positions; strength uniform[0,1).

language: original target instruction unchanged in all arms

feedback.current_frames: up to four recent unmodified paired policy observations
feedback.previous_rollout: last completed attempt's four raw paired snapshots, decisions and outcome
feedback.donor_previews: two contact sheets with all45 paired sample IDs; full pixels used by policy

stopping: Common recovered-noise baseline, then at most two revisions independently per arm; stop at first success. Development forces one intervention even after baseline success. Known-noise and fresh-noise controls each run once. Every provider call including rejection consumes one scheduled decision slot and its usage is counted.
claim_scope: Exploratory image-input rescue on20 known OOD compositions with new seed37 resets, separately measured baseline. Three previously inspected seed19 cases are development only. Restricted donor library and unknown checkpoint training overlap preclude held-out or zero-shot claims. Images and language/noise are isolated in this study; no gain attributed to redundant inversion.
